cases.description: Complete dish approval and diner display
expected_results: Owner correction persists after successful save and reload
Only explicitly approved revisions are published
Diner sees the approved dish and permitted T0 image
Successful direct Save emits dish_saved with save_origin=direct
Reload restores saved state without duplicate Save event
Missing required ingredients prevent complete publication
Incomplete placeholder does not emit dish_viewed
Blocked detail does not emit dish_detail_opened
Blocked comparison does not emit dish_compared
Missing evidence never implies allergen safety
Unapproved draft changes do not replace published content
Explicitly approved replacement becomes visible on fresh load
Withdrawn dish is unavailable on a fresh diner load
Events reference the applicable publication revision

cases.description: Save, Unsave, Undo, and storage failures
expected_results: Successful direct Save emits dish_saved with save_origin=direct
Successful Unsave emits dish_unsaved
Successful Undo emits dish_saved with save_origin=undo
Failed storage operations emit no success events
Successful readable Saved screen emits shortlist_viewed
Failed Saved screen read emits no shortlist_viewed
Reload does not emit a duplicate Save event
Search and ingredient interactions emit no P0 events
Restaurant A owner cannot access Restaurant B protected data
Restaurant B owner cannot access Restaurant A protected data
Revoked owner cannot perform protected operations
Outsider cannot access protected restaurant resources
Rejected requests do not modify protected data
cases.blocker: Disposable staging identities and authorization evidence required
